<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Anti-paper leak Bill:</strong> Following days of deadlock and opposition protests, political parties have agreed to hold a 10-hour debate on the anti-paper leak Bill in the Lok Sabha starting July 29.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I18</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Parliamentary conduct:</strong> Tensions escalated in Parliament as BJP MPs gave a rousing welcome to former Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan, prompting sharp criticism from the Congress party, which labeled the gesture an insult to the youth.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I25</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I26</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I41</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I43</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi__?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I45</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Legislative progress:</strong> Both Houses of Parliament successfully passed the Transgender Persons Amendment Bill, 2026, and the Jan Vishwas (Amendment of Provisions) Bill, 2026.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxOS1Y3RmZzYUVKcWZEU082Q3J2S210X3k5NEVLdmVkbTY2TlBsNFZIR2FoWFBrQTFaMDYwcXE3clIzTDN4VV83US1LUmxwd2FVeVZsNW5YeVZHU0ZMUnJLZjhTVjBnRFE2Y2ZpZTMtOWVqYU1TX3BNTHRvZjhscE1yT1JsRjVFYnFITm9GbVVkNEdkVjFrSTNvYldVUU1zSjlGaVZoZDE3T0x1Vmx5VW5ONnNvc0xxQU5kTlkw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I23</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTFBmb01LMTRlbExGcXB3RmRRZjNfLVBRdUlmd2pQX254WGx4MGR1YWdPQkRrRWRLR3BmdGlrUG5JSzllNElQRVhIT1dFYk1mZjAzaENnUjFUbFczUVpVNmNMUlo5Y25SQUpuWTBOZlNuMnV3cGdWTEhXSEk4YWY?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I24</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Protests and adjournments:</strong> Both Houses faced repeated adjournments as the Opposition staged protests against alleged police brutality toward NEET demonstrators and demanded an apology from the Home Minister.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W15</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W16</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W17</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Judicial matters:</strong> The Supreme Court has reserved its verdict on a plea by Abu Salem seeking premature release and has issued notice regarding Union Minister Suresh Gopi’s challenge to a Kerala High Court decision concerning his election victory.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxOa2pqYXhZZjM2R216VU1UenE2TEdfd2ZHWDhaM0s2WXFWVkxYZzN6SWpUZDBQQUxnVXZsNkJTY04wSEg5bk5yN0hTR2dPUjJMZEZvUGR5aFFmd0xGVzFNWWdHNlhsQ3FRa0xNelpOYy1wYWFFdERaQ1pKNjFaVUZvb0NlQ1dSNUxGMFpnSXBQa2VFMktFaDFoeXd0aWJpdFk?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W18</a></span></li>
</ul>
